svg.title: cc hello.c is four programs, and each leaves a file
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “cc hello.c is four programs, and each leaves a file” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Five file chips in a row — hello.c, hello.i, hello.s, hello.o and hello — joined by four arrows labelled cpp, clang -S, clang -c and ld, with the measured byte count under each file. A red crossed-out box denies that compilation is one step. Below, an nm listing shows _main defined and _printf unresolved, and a tall stack of bands draws the resulting process address space from __PAGEZERO up to the stack.
svg.text: cc hello.c is four programs, and each leaves a file
draw it from memory, then compare
